name: SVC_EA_EVENTS
description: To maintain the notifications from events received by Engage Adapter from Fusion Service business objects create, update, and delete events. These events will handle Fusion routing requests and callbacks to and from Engage Adapter and Engage Services.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Primary key populated from a sequence.

columns.name: ROOT_EVENT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier to connect event hierarchy.

columns.name: EVENT_NUMBER
columns.description: The event public unique identifier.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the event type triggered by the source service.

columns.name: SOURCE_EVENT_ID
columns.description: The event identifier in the source service.

columns.name: EVENT_OWNER
columns.description: Indicates the source service of this event.

columns.name: OBJECT_NUMBER
columns.description: Business object number of the business object that triggered this event.

columns.name: INTERACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates what type of interaction or business object type associated with this event.

columns.name: UWO_ID
columns.description: Universal work object unique ID of the routing process associated to the business object.

columns.name: PAYLOAD
columns.description: The representation of the payload received in this event.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Indicates the current status of the process that is received in this event.

columns.name: STATUS_MESSAGE
columns.description: Any message associated to the status of this event.

columns.name: BO_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date and time when the business object was last updated in the source service.

columns.name: EVENT_CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date and time when the event originally started in the source service.

columns.name: EVENT_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date and time when the event was last updated in the source service.

columns.name: PARENT_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Parent event unique ID.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
